item.title: Family of man who was killed, dismembered asks for time to heal
item.description: Family members of a man who was found dismembered in a Winston-Salem townhouse on Monday are devastated by his death and are asking the public to respect their privacy and give them time to heal.

item.title: How many kids sick at your child's school? Winston-Salem doctors create app to track it
item.description: Two Winston-Salem doctors have created an app called Sneez that they hope will decrease the spread of illnesses.

item.title: UPDATED: Authorities identify man who drowned in Belews Lake on Sunday
item.description: BELEWS CREEK — A 19-year-old Walkertown man, described by friends as helpful and well-mannered, drowned in Belews Lake on Sunday.

item.title: Reward offered in 2-year-old Greensboro homicide
item.description: Greensboro Police are looking for leads in the shooting death of Michael Anthony Lovett on Oct. 8, 2016.

item.description: Austin Ybarra can look around a coaching staff meeting and recognize why he’s unique. He doesn’t think about it often, but the reality is always there.

item.title: Patti Labelle will be the Saturday headliner at the 11th John Coltrane International Jazz and Blues Festival in High Point
item.description: The Friends of John Coltrane have announced that Patti LaBelle will be the Saturday headliner for the 11th John Coltrane International Jazz and Blues Festival, which will return to High Point on Sept. 3-4.

item.title: Gears & Guitars music festival announces lineup and that concerts will be free
item.description: Gears & Guitars made a double-whammy announcement today: a star-studded music lineup and the news that all the live music this year — Sept. 9-11 — will be free.
